title: DSH Plugin Manifest
description: The manifest schema for a plugin entry in the dsh-marketplace registry. One JSON file per plugin under registry/plugins/<id>/plugin.json.

id.description: Stable, machine-friendly plugin id. Also the directory name under registry/plugins/.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the marketplace UI.

version.description: Semver version of the plugin as listed in this entry.

description.description: One- to two-sentence description of what the plugin does.

descriptionZh.description: Optional Chinese description shown first in the marketplace UI.

category.description: Coarse bucket used for marketplace filtering.

install.description: How a user installs this plugin through the dsh CLI.

target.description: The kind of package spec (npm registry package, git host, or a local file: path).

spec.description: The package/git spec fed to `dsh plugin add`. For npm: the package name. For git: e.g. github:owner/repo.

command.description: The exact install command with a {profile} placeholder for the profile name.

verified.description: True when a maintainer has reviewed and verified the plugin's safety and install path.
